title: kithctl watch: fit_col(max=1) returns original string — off-by-one in truncation guard
description: fit_col in main.rs (line 105) checks 'chars.len() > max && max >= 2'. When max=1, a string longer than 1 char skips the truncation branch (max >= 2 is false) and is returned verbatim, overrunning the column. The contact list hardcodes column widths of 30 and 25 so this never fires in practice, but the function contract is wrong for max=1. If max=0, the function returns empty string (correct), but max=1 with a long string would overflow the column.
